profile.headline: Software Development Engineer In Test at Hexaware Technologies Ltd.

positions.title: Buyer Specialist
positions.description:
- Conduct accurate and effective ordering for product.
- Maintain correct pricing and signage to appropriately reflect product costs.
- Monitor movement, promotions, profitability, values, and regional guidance.
- Participate in regional and national sales promotions.
- Analyze data to forecast projected sales.
- Coordinate successful plans for profitability
- Use analytics to assess profit margins, targets, incremental sale goals.

positions.title: Supervisor/Booth Team Member
positions.description:
- Monitor register floor and cashier necessities.
- Ensure that appropriate customer service standards are being met
- Process register tills, refunds, returns, and customer concerns.
